internal_faq.question: How fast are the alerts — my current broker takes 15 minutes?
internal_faq.answer: TradeEasy Price Alerts are delivered via push notification within 30 seconds of a price crossing your threshold during market hours (9:30–4:00 PM ET). That's real-time, not delayed. If push fails for any reason, an email fallback sends within 5 minutes.

internal_faq.question: Will an alert automatically execute a trade for me?
internal_faq.answer: No — alerts are informational only. When your target price is crossed, you receive a notification and can choose to open a pre-filled order ticket. You always decide whether to trade. This is intentionally different from limit orders.

internal_faq.question: How many alerts can I set?
internal_faq.answer: You can have up to 20 active alerts at one time. Triggered alerts move to your Alert History and free up a slot. You can re-arm any triggered alert with one tap if you want to watch that level again.

internal_faq.question: Does this work on the web app too?
internal_faq.answer: Web users receive email alerts instead of push notifications in the current release. Push notifications for web browsers are planned for a future update. If you use the iOS or Android app, you'll get the full real-time push experience.

internal_faq.question: What types of assets can I set alerts on?
internal_faq.answer: Price Alerts support US equities and ETFs — the same universe available for trading on TradeEasy today. Options alerts, futures, and international equities are not supported in this release and are on the future roadmap.
